goal: Prevent inbound Tor connections from misclassifying as IP peers and gaining whitelist permissions
Require a dedicated onion bind at startup when automatic Tor listening is enabled
agreement: Contested objection: existing single-bind setups will fail startup upon upgrade (sedited)
Interface proposal to replace -listenonion with -bind=addr:port=onionauto remains open (vasild)
Support agreeing dedicated binds are necessary and container setups can set specific IPs (vasild)
Verified by building and testing on FreeBSD (winterrdog)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because Tor peers arriving through shared binds can inherit address-based whitelist permissions
Eliminates an unintended security exposure for node operators running automatic Tor services
